title: Turkish Cream Tart
description: A keto dessert featuring a velvety Turkish cream filling in a briny pastry crust. A delicious twist on a classic dessert.

ingredients.name: Pastry Crust
ingredients.notes: use a food processor to mix the crust

ingredients.name: Turkish Cream Filling
ingredients.notes: chill in the fridge for at least 2 hours

instructions: In a food processor, mix together almond flour, unsalted butter and salt until a dough forms.
Press dough into a 9-inch tart pan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until lightly golden.
In a separate bowl, mix together heavy cream, unsalted butter and Patissiere Cream.
Pour the mixture into the baked tart shell.
Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden.
Dust with powdered sugar before serving.
